## When to Visit Cappadocia? The Short Answer

The best time to visit Cappadocia is **April to June and September to October**. At the Nevşehir station the 1981-2010 average daily maximum is 16.3-25.6 °C in April-June and 19.1-25.3 °C in September-October, mild enough for early-morning balloon flights and valley walks. Winter is colder, quieter and suits snow photography.

## Month by Month: Temperatures at Nevşehir

The figures below are official 1981-2010 climate normals from the Turkish State Meteorological Service (MGM) for the Nevşehir station. They describe average conditions, not a forecast. Crowds and prices are described in general terms; check current rates with the operator or hotel.

| Month | Avg. temp (°C) | Avg. max / min (°C) | What to expect |
|---|---|---|---|
| January | 0.0 | 4.1 / -3.5 | Cold, snow possible, very quiet |
| February | 1.3 | 6.0 / -2.6 | Cold, snow possible, short Valentine's peak |
| March | 5.5 | 10.9 / 1.0 | Cool transition month |
| April | 10.4 | 16.3 / 5.2 | Spring begins, busier |
| May | 15.0 | 21.2 / 9.3 | Mild, popular |
| June | 18.9 | 25.6 / 12.3 | Warm, long days |
| July | 22.2 | 29.3 / 14.6 | Hot afternoons, cool mornings |
| August | 22.1 | 29.4 / 14.5 | Hot afternoons, busy holiday season |
| September | 18.1 | 25.3 / 11.3 | Mild, popular |
| October | 12.8 | 19.1 / 7.4 | Cooler, autumn colours |
| November | 6.3 | 11.6 / 2.1 | Cold, quieter |
| December | 2.0 | 6.2 / -1.4 | Cold, snow possible, New Year peak |

Source: MGM, Nevşehir climate normals 1981-2010.

## Spring: April to June

Spring is the most balanced season. Afternoons are comfortable for walking in the valleys, evenings are cool, and the days lengthen. It is also one of the busiest periods, so book accommodation and your balloon flight early. A balloon ride, a Red or Green tour and a sunset activity fit comfortably into one day. See [/aktiviteler](/en/activities) for activities such as ATV, jeep and horse riding.

## Summer: July and August

Average maximums reach about 29 °C, and the record high at Nevşehir is 39.5 °C (July). Plan outdoor activities for the morning and evening and use the afternoon for the pool or a visit to an underground city. Cave rooms stay naturally cooler than the outside air. Summer is a popular holiday period, so book ahead.

## Autumn: September and October

September keeps the warmth of summer with fewer crowds; October brings cooler days and autumn colours that photographers like. Wine tastings and valley walks are good plans for this season. Nights get chilly by late October, so bring a warm layer.

## Winter: November to March

Winter is cold: average minimums are below freezing from December to February, with record lows of -21.2 °C in January and -23.6 °C in February. The highest recorded snow depth at Nevşehir is 64 cm (2 February 1992). Snow on the fairy chimneys is a rare sight and a draw for photographers and couples. Wind, low cloud and snow can disrupt balloon flights, so keep your schedule flexible. Cave hotels hold warmth well. Some seasonal facilities, such as glamping sites, may close.

## Do Balloons Fly Every Day?

No. Balloon flights depend on wind and visibility, and the operator decides on the morning of the flight. Balloon operations in the EU framework are governed by Commission Regulation (EU) 2018/395 (EASA); the pilot and operator, not the guest, decide whether conditions are safe. Trip and Tick offers a **100% refund or a free date change** if your flight is cancelled for weather. Leave at least one spare day in your itinerary.

Trip and Tick's standard balloon flight starts **from EUR 100**; see [/balonlar](/en/balloon-tours). Packages are price on request via WhatsApp: [/paketler](/en/packages).

## Getting There

Nevşehir Cappadocia Airport (LTAZ) is about 30 km north-west of Nevşehir (DHMI). Kayseri Airport (LTAU) is about 5 km north of Kayseri. Private transfers with Trip and Tick start **from EUR 35** (Nevşehir airport to hotel) and **from EUR 55** (Kayseri airport to hotel).

## Choosing a Month: Quick Guide

- **Best balance of weather and activities:** April-June, September
- **Fewer crowds, cooler weather:** October-November, March
- **Snow photography and quiet:** December-February
- **Hot weather, holiday atmosphere:** July-August

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is the best month to visit Cappadocia?
May and September are the most balanced months, with average maximums of 21.2 °C and 25.3 °C at Nevşehir. April, June and October are also good. Choose by what you want: warmth, fewer crowds or autumn colours.

### Do balloons fly in Cappadocia in winter?
They can, but winter has more weather-related cancellations because of wind, low cloud and snow. Operators decide on the day. Trip and Tick offers a 100% refund or a free date change if the flight is cancelled for weather.

### When does it snow in Cappadocia?
Snow is possible from December to February, the coldest months. Nevşehir's highest recorded snow depth is 64 cm (2 February 1992). Snowfall varies from year to year, so it cannot be guaranteed on a given date.

### Is Cappadocia too hot in summer?
Afternoons are hot, with average maximums of about 29 °C in July and August and a record high of 39.5 °C. Mornings and evenings are much cooler, so plan outdoor activities then and rest in the afternoon.

### How cold does Cappadocia get in winter?
Average minimums are -3.5 °C in January, -2.6 °C in February and -1.4 °C in December. Record lows reach -21.2 °C in January and -23.6 °C in February. Pack warm layers and waterproof shoes.

### Is it worth going to Cappadocia in winter?
Yes, if you value quiet and snow scenery and accept weather risk. Plan flexible dates, stay in a cave hotel for the warmth, and keep a spare day for balloon flights.

### How far is the airport from Cappadocia?
Nevşehir Cappadocia Airport (LTAZ) is about 30 km north-west of Nevşehir; Kayseri Airport (LTAU) is about 5 km north of Kayseri. Trip and Tick transfers start from EUR 35 and EUR 55 respectively.
